slides.headline: Are you *token maxing*? 5 signs you've crossed the line
01 · Your weekly limit is gone by *Wednesday*

graphic.label: to burn through most of it. It used to last *all week*.

slides.title: You upgraded your plan
slides.subtitle: And you're *still* rationing.
slides.body: Doom moved up to the $100 plan and still has more he wants to run. Every extra project now competes for the same weekly allowance.

slides.title: You run nerd-at-night projects
slides.subtitle: Automations work while you *sleep*.
slides.body: Side projects and background automations quietly eat tokens. Doom had to audit his to find which ones he could switch off.

slides.headline: 04 · You know your *reset schedule* by heart

graphic.text: If I was at an org that could just run it, I'd be *token maxing*.

slides.title: Tokens are the new cloud bill
slides.subtitle: Usage only goes *one way*.
slides.body: Token prices keep falling, but usage grows faster. Quinn's take: tokens will seep into everything we do, quietly, like the internet did.
